# Driver Requirements Checklist: Low-Resource Reliable macOS Audio

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of macOS driver, route lifecycle, realtime-safety, and recovery requirements before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Items test the requirements and design artifacts, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are virtual device publication requirements complete for visibility, alive state, hidden state, idle running state, and fail-closed behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Visibility Rules]
- [ ] CHK002 Are client activity requirements complete for microphone-only, speaker-only, both-device, brief open/close, and silent-but-open stream scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §US1, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Activation Rules]
- [ ] CHK003 Are route lifecycle states complete enough to cover idle-safe, starting, ready, active, stale, blocked, failed, retrying, and fallback outcomes? [Completeness, Data Model §Audio Resource State, Contract §States]
- [ ] CHK004 Are physical working-device requirements complete for built-in, wired, 2brain virtual, other virtual, aggregate, multi-output, Bluetooth, and unknown devices? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-024, Data Model §Physical Working Device Selection]
- [ ] CHK005 Are `coreaudiod` restart, sleep/wake, physical device change, stale browser device ID, app exit, and stale heartbeat recovery requirements all represented? [Completeness, Spec §US3, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Failure Semantics]
- [ ] CHK006 Are fallback requirements complete enough to define when the accepted 005 route lifecycle is preserved or restored without driver reinstall? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-017, Contract §Fallback Boundary]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the distinction between virtual device publication and live route readiness unambiguous across spec, data model, and route lifecycle contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Data Model §Route Truth Snapshot, Contract §Readiness Planes]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "lightweight idle" defined with enough specificity to distinguish it from hidden devices, muted routes, and sustained heavy physical passthrough work? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §Audio Resource State]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the 3-second startup bound consistently defined for slow setup, blocked setup, fallback, and validation evidence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-004, Data Model §Startup Attempt Evidence]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the expected behavior for a default-selected virtual speaker receiving active audio clearly defined so resource saving cannot be interpreted as intentional muting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-027, Contract §Activation Rules]
- [ ] CHK011 Are unsupported virtual/aggregate/multi-output route requirements clear enough to avoid accidental acceptance during implementation planning? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024, Data Model §Physical Working Device Selection, Contract §Physical Device Rules]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are visible fail-closed device requirements consistent between the spec, research decisions, data model, and route lifecycle contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, Research §Phase 0 Decisions, Data Model §Virtual Device Publication Evidence]
- [ ] CHK013 Are app heartbeat requirements consistent with the selected MVP behavior that stale heartbeat downgrades readiness but does not hide public devices? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-023, Data Model §App Bridge Health Evidence]
- [ ] CHK014 Are route ownership requirements consistent between driver responsibilities, app route engine responsibilities, and future recording layer responsibilities? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Contract §Ownership, Data Model §Recording Trigger Boundary]
- [ ] CHK015 Are promotion and fallback requirements consistent with the rule that low-resource mode becomes default only after all local P1 gates pass? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-008, Contract §Promotion Rule]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Are route startup outcomes measurable with explicit states, timing threshold, and metadata-only evidence fields? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Data Model §Startup Attempt Evidence]
- [ ] CHK017 Are no-hang and CPU requirements measurable for target surfaces, time threshold, CPU threshold, and blocked/not accepted outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-005, Contract §Required Gates]
- [ ] CHK018 Are active-stream requirements objectively measurable without using audio energy as the deciding signal? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011, Data Model §Client Activity Evidence]
- [ ] CHK019 Are realtime-safety requirements stated in a way that can support a static/manual requirements gate before implementation? [Measurability, Spec §FR-020, Spec §SC-014, Contract §Realtime Safety]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for route startup when Core Audio enumeration is slow, blocked, or overloaded? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-006, Contract §Failure Semantics]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for app exit while 2brain Rec virtual devices remain selected as system or app defaults? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a future recording trigger subscribing while passthrough is already active, without changing driver ownership? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §Recording Trigger Boundary]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK023 Are platform and target-device assumptions documented for Apple Silicon macOS, installed local package, and built-in/wired release-quality physical devices? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Target Platform]
- [ ] CHK024 Are dependencies on Core Audio, AudioToolbox, AudioServerPlugIn, shared memory, and local validation harnesses documented without leaving architecture-critical choices implicit? [Dependency, Plan §Primary Dependencies]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK025 Is any remaining conflict between older hide-on-heartbeat behavior and 006 visible fail-closed behavior explicitly resolved before tasks are generated? [Conflict, Spec §Current Baseline And Scope Decision, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK026 Are terms such as "ready", "active", "alive", "visible", "running", "stale", and "fail-closed" consistently defined and not used interchangeably? [Terminology, Data Model §Audio Resource State, Contract §Readiness Planes]
